55962.summary: The class discusses the roles and responsibilities of women in ecclesial life based on 1 Corinthians 11 and 1 Timothy 2, emphasizing the complementary nature of men and women in partnership and the importance of spiritual equality despite the order of submission.

55963.summary: The class covers questions about sisters' roles in ecclesial governance, including committee appointments and handling ecclesial problems. It also discusses wives supporting their husbands spiritually and practical advice for family life, emphasizing the importance of daily readings and prayer.
